elaine: Quick note for the gardeners: propose a 'orchard graft' pattern to steadily remove shared hotpaths from session-sidecar. Small, testable grafts (one per sprint) instead of big refactors. Want quick sanity checks.

toni: Explain graft vs peel?

elaine: Graft = add a tiny tenant-local companion (graft process) that handles one responsibility (cache, rate-limit, coalescer). Run in shadow, then route cohort, then detach. Keeps main tree healthy while we harvest debt.

kevin: Migration steps?

elaine: Shadow -> sticky-route -> authoritative -> prune. Each step has a 48h observation window and automated rollback triggers.

priya: What gates?

elaine: p95_latency, error_rate, cache_hit_ratio (if applicable), and evaluation-quality. Rollback if p95 > +10% or errors +1% absolute. Also track graft_mem and graft_qdepth.

orchard-bot: /epic create orchard-grafts-1 -> id og-174880

kevin: Ops surface: how many knobs?

elaine: One binary, flags for mem_budget & concurrency. Default small. Only large tenants get custom config. Observability standardized: traces tagged graft=true and tenant_cohort.

toni: Canary cadence?

elaine: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 24h holds at 5% and 25%. Shadow runs for 48h before canary.

kevin: Who writes RFC and timeline?

elaine: I'll draft the RFC this week. @kevin will add cost model, @priya writes eviction policy and runbook. Action items:
- elaine: RFC draft by Fri
- kevin: cost projection by Mon
- priya: eviction + runbook by Mon

elaine: Will post RFC link here and attach sample dashboards (p95, errors, graft_mem, debt-meter).
